clock_in.result: passed: every phase's median within 0.03 tick of the reference, in both runs (bar: 0.5 tick)
clock_in.method: build/ scripts (not committed): the Mac sends MIDI clock at 90 bpm to the rig (its own tempo 120) while it plays the 808 Kit slot, and records the rig's USB audio with a copy of tools/fm1_rec.swift that prints each 4096-frame buffer's AVAudioEngine host time; each hit is placed in host time through the buffer it falls in, on the clock the MIDI sends use (the method of #1113). Phases: reference, the clock running a bar before Start; the Start-first host, Start then its first clock a tick later; an 800 ms stall, then the clock goes on; an 800 ms stall, then the missed ticks in a burst; a Start while running, 10 ticks short of a bar line. Each hit is compared with the reference's median offset from the eighth-note grid.
clock_in.runs: run 1: Start-first -0.01, stall -0.01, stall with burst -0.03, before the restart -0.04, after the restart -0.02 tick (medians); every hit within -0.42..+0.10. Run 2: +0.02, 0.00, +0.02, +0.02, -0.01; every hit within -0.07..+0.17 except the first hit at the burst itself (+1.61). The reference sits 0.40 to 0.43 tick after the first clock after Start, the output latency #1113 measured.
